title: Duplicate Domain Auto-Renew Charges: Compensation Basis by Time to Refund
content:
> Harborline Customer Accounts, for duplicate auto-renew charges on Domain Registrations

The compensation basis of the duplicate-charge goodwill depends on how long the duplicate stood, measured as the days until the duplicate was refunded (the calendar days from the duplicate charge's date to its refund line's date):

- **7 days or more:** the duplicate charge's full amount plus $3.00 for each started week of those days.
- **3 or more but fewer than 7 days:** $6.00 flat.
- **Fewer than 3 days:** 0.25 (25 percent) of the duplicate charge's amount.

A started week counts in full: 7 days are one started week, 12 days are two.

**Worked illustrations, hypothetical duplicate of $27.60.**

| Days until refunded | Basis |
|---|---|
| 2 | $6.90 |
| 3 | $6.00 |
| 6 | $6.00 |
| 7 | $27.60 plus $3.00, $30.60 |
| 12 | $27.60 plus $6.00, $33.60 |
